article.hook: The argument isn’t about who’s right - it’s about who stays in the room. Jupiter in Libra pushes us toward expanding what we can build together, even if the ground keeps shifting underfoot.
article.lived: For about a year, conversations stretch longer and meetings multiply as we test what fair really means. You’ll notice offers and compromises landing in your lap, some so polished they sound like deals too good to pass up. This is luck showing up as the chance to bloom through connection - growth that feels like a handshake rather than a solo sprint.
article.turn: But the gift of relationship can turn into the grind of endless negotiation. When you keep adjusting to others’ terms, you lose track of your own. The real loss isn’t indecision - it’s trading your voice for a quiet that never lasts.
